items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: but in the studio when we recorded that I could not believe the things coming out of her mouth

ctx.x: I mean you hear [mimics] “Marian McPartland” you know and she’s all proper and everything, but in the studio when we recorded that I could not believe the things coming out of her mouth, it was so great. And then she’d get back on the mic all proper and everything. It was so funny. I don’t remember that. I need to dig that up.
Listen to it, yeah, and it’s funny because at the end of it she said something like, “Well you really can’t go wrong with this.”
